description_en: Changes the node specifications of a PolarDB cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-node-class --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --modify-type Upgrade --db-node-target-class polar.mysql.x4.large --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBNodeClass

parameters.help_en:
The type of the specification change. Valid values: 
Upgrade: upgrades the specifications.
Downgrade: downgrades the specifications
parameters.help_zh:
变更类型，取值范围如下： 
Upgrade：升级规格
Downgrade：降级规格
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The target specifications for all nodes. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html
parameters.help_zh: 所有节点的目标规格，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html。
parameters.name: db_node_target_class

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The earliest start time of the scheduled specification change task. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).
This parameter takes effect when `ModifyType` is set to `Upgrade` or `Downgrade`.
The start time must be within the next 24 hours. For example, if the current time is `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`, the valid range for the start time is from `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` to `2021-01-15T09:00:00Z`.
If this parameter is left empty, the specification change task is immediately executed
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）升降级配置任务的最早时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
当`ModifyType`取值为`Upgrade`或`Downgrade`时，该参数生效。
开始时间的取值范围为未来24小时内的任意时间点。例如当前时间为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`，此处允许填入的开始时间范围为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`~`2021-01-15T09:00:00Z`。
若该参数留空，默认立即执行升级配置任务
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The latest start time of the scheduled specification change task. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).
The latest time must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If `PlannedStartTime` is set but this parameter is not specified, the latest time defaults to `start time + 30 minutes`. For example, if `PlannedStartTime` is set to `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` and this parameter is left empty, the task starts no later than `2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
最晚时间需晚于开始时间的30分钟或以上。
若设置了`PlannedStartTime`但未指定该参数，执行目标任务的最晚时间默认为`开始时间+30分钟`。例如当设置`PlannedStartTime`为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`且该参数留空时，目标任务最晚将于`2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`开始执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The cluster sub-series. Valid values:

normal_exclusive: Dedicated

normal_general: General-purpose

This parameter is required when you change specifications between Dedicated and General-purpose
parameters.help_zh:
集群子系列。取值范围如下：

normal_exclusive：独享规格

normal_general：通用规格

若独享共享之间规格相互变配，subcategory 这个字段为必填项
parameters.name: sub_category

parameters.help_en: The node type. Set this parameter to DLNode only when you change the node specifications of an AI node
parameters.help_zh: 节点类型，当且仅当修改ai节点规格时取值固定为DLNode
parameters.name: db_node_type

parameters.help_en: The cloud service provider of the instance
parameters.name: cloud_provider

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): Uses coupons.
false: Does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If this parameter is not specified, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code
